setup.memory_card_desc: Automatically learns facts, preferences, and relationships in the background during dialogues, querying the neural graph in real-time.
setup.feature_local_desc: Associative graph stored only on your machine (~/.atena/). No data is sent to cloud servers.
setup.feature_tokens_desc: Compact prompt injection (~800 to 1,200 tokens) structured for Prefix Caching (KV Cache reuse), keeping inference fast.
setup.feature_private_desc: Chats with Private Mode enabled completely bypass memory (zero reading and zero writing).
setup.beta_notice: Atena Studio and Cognitive Memory are currently in Beta. You can toggle this option anytime in Settings.
setup.step4_desc: Atena automatically discovers models in system directories and allows adding custom folders:
setup.step5_desc: Your AI engines, preferences, and memory have been successfully configured.
